features.name: Audit before functional verification
features.description:
Audit before functional verification - feature F-1 of workplan storybook-framework-requests.
Run the code audit (/audit-build) before the functional-verification loop in /implement-trd's end-of-run sequence, its NEXT text and /verify-build's hand-off, so audit fixes land before verification and its evidence is produced once on the final code. The PR still opens only after both. Keep /audit-build usable alone.
Acceptance: the command text and docs state audit first, tests pin it, a fixture session runs the audit step first.
Builds on: none.
Decisions: alongside means audit runs first, not in parallel: OWNER-CALL (PM, 2026-11-16).
Design: docs/plans/storybook-framework-requests/roadmap.md item 1.
Scope: this feature only. Other features of the plan are built separately; reference them as existing or to-come, never build them.

features.name: Cap verification runs per feature
features.description:
Cap verification runs per feature - feature F-2 of workplan storybook-framework-requests.
Count full verification runs per feature in implement.json (functional_verification.runs), kept across verify, refine and resume. After 2 full runs, stop recovering and write one ruling request listing everything still open (ship, fix one named thing, drop it). The limit is a setting defaulting to 2.
Acceptance: the run counter survives resume, a third run is refused with a ruling request, /refine-verification declines a third plan.
Builds on: none.
Related: Audit before functional verification: touches the same end-of-run order; neither needs the other built.
Decisions: the ruling goes to the product PM, who may escalate: OWNER-CALL (PM, 2026-11-16).
Design: docs/plans/storybook-framework-requests/roadmap.md item 2.

features.name: Core boards in designs
features.description:
Core boards in designs - feature F-3 of workplan storybook-framework-requests.
In /create-design and its siblings mark at most 8 Core boards (main screens, normal state) with a visible Core mark on the canvas and a flag in design-map.json. Core boards stay must-pass pixel-perfect comparisons; all other boards are evidence only and never fail verification, their behaviour proven by forced-state component tests. Older designs count every board as Core until refined.
Acceptance: a 12-board fixture design yields 8 must-pass and 4 evidence-only criteria; the canvas shows the Core mark.
Builds on: none.
Deferred: the visible Core mark on a live canvas waits on a design round using the canvas service.
Design: docs/plans/storybook-framework-requests/roadmap.md item 3.

features.name: Publish artifacts per kind
features.description:
Publish artifacts per kind - feature F-4 of workplan storybook-framework-requests.
Replace the single publishArtifacts switch with a per-kind setting. Default publishes trd, task and spike reports and design canvases; for verification-report, audit-build, audit-prd, audit-trd and check-skill pages only the path is recorded unless the run is asked to publish. publishArtifacts false still turns all off and a rebase never reverses it; true maps to the new default. Update every reading command, the settings template, scaffold-project.sh, the artifacts library and docs.
Acceptance: settings resolution tests pass, a refresh keeps an owner's false, no command reads the old boolean directly.
Builds on: none.
